speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I see you are presenting with shortness of breath, increased abdominal girth, and a large ovarian mass. To better understand your condition, have you been experiencing any pain in your abdomen or pelvic region?

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the background; given your 40-year-old age and nulliparity, have you noticed any abnormal vaginal bleeding or spotting recently? I will also need to see your ultrasound results to assess the characteristics of that ovarian mass. REQUEST IMAGES: Pelvic_Ultrasound

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Ovarian Cancer causing Malignant Ascites and Pleural Effusion.

The combination of a large ovarian mass, significant abdominal girth, and shortness of breath in a 40-year-old woman strongly suggests advanced ovarian cancer with ascites and pleural effusion. I have requested the Pelvic Ultrasound and relevant images to confirm the mass characteristics and fluid status.
